newsitem.title: USA: American Management cutting Q4 estimates.
newsitem.headline: American Management cutting Q4 estimates.

text.p: American Management Systems Inc said Monday it expects to report fourth-quarter earnings that are lower than previously expected because of a delay in the completion of a large project.
The delay will reduce the company's 1996 earnings and revenue, it said.
The company said it will report earings of $0.81 to $0.85 per share for 1996.
It did not identify the large project or provide further details.
The company could not be reached for further comment.
The company had been expected to earn $0.93 a share for fiscal 1996, based on the average estimate of seven analysts surveyed by First Call.
The same analysts estimated the company would earn $0.32 share for the fourth quarter.
